objective: Operate Argo CD continuously and prove the approved private delivery path from infrastructure to Hoodi client and validator-oriented workloads.
authorization: User explicitly authorized creation and live execution of the GitOps repository, always-on Argo CD, Vault-integrated release path, and client workload.
constraints: Keep Vault recovery material, tokens, keys, kubeconfigs, and secret values out of Git, state, logs, and evidence.
Use the private EKS endpoint and private runners only.
Keep consensus and execution pools scalable to zero after the end-to-end proof; keep the system pool at one node for Argo CD.
successCriteria: A private GitOps repository exists with immutable reviewed workload input.
Argo CD is installed on the private EKS cluster and remains Healthy on the always-on system pool.
Vault is initialized, sealed-state healthy, and its Transit signer policy passes sign and verify without key export.
Argo CD syncs a pinned workload revision and both client StatefulSets become Ready.
Validator use cases have distinct key-management boundaries, deny paths, recovery steps, and no key overlap with CI or Transit signing.
Evidence records non-sensitive live checks and rollback/scale-down actions.
